calculation.description: Cross-asset short-term reversal signal: fade the trailing three-day return, normalized by trailing 20-day daily volatility. The clipping limits the influence of extreme observations. Signal is computed using information available at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.045601), 2023-2024 (0.023214), and 2025-2027 (0.033582). The daily gate is passed across the full 1,853-date sample; predictive strength decays beyond the daily horizon.
validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation against next-day close return; dates with at least 8 valid instruments; 15-asset tradable benchmark universe.
